sections.title: Quarterly revenue
sections.callout: Outlook: AMD guided Q1 2026 revenue to about $9.8B, plus or minus $0.3B, with a non-GAAP gross margin of about 55%.

footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income: includes a $103M income tax benefit, $66M from discontinued operations, $26M from equity income.

AMD recorded a $0.1B tax benefit, $0.03B of equity income and $0.07B from discontinued operations in FY2025, so net income exceeds pre-tax income; the flow chart shows pre-tax income flowing to net income.
Operating cash flow is from continuing operations; free cash flow as reported by AMD. Total liabilities = total assets − equity.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: AMD's revenue grew 34.3% to a record $34.6B in 2025. Data Center rose 32.2% to $16.6B, and Client and Gaming together jumped 50.8% to $14.6B. Operating income nearly doubled to $3.7B despite about $0.44B of charges tied to export controls on its MI308 AI chips.
Net income rose 2.6 times to $4.3B, or $2.65 per diluted share. Free cash flow more than doubled to $5.5B, and cash and short-term investments rose to $10.6B.
highlights: Q4 2025 revenue reached a record $10.3B, up 34.1%.
Client and Gaming operating income rose 2.4 times to $2.9B.
Net cash more than doubled to $7.3B.
watch: Data Center operating margin slipped to 21.7% from 27.7%.
Export controls on MI308 chips to China cost about $0.44B of net charges.
Amortization from past acquisitions still cost $2.3B across cost of sales and operating expenses.
